answer: A payout is split which means 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The zenith schedule is applied in onyx and delta exposes each instalment. A hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2525 identities would post 4352 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
